rows.name: geometry (h,v,R,N,W,T,m)
rows.lean: D2Data: defs h v Rslots N W Tmp m + decide identity pins (Consts/WireLayout pattern)

rows.name: wire layout (wX,wY,wS,wT,wU,g1,g2,rho_n)
rows.source: structural: 2v entrance, R aux slots, h centre/late wires (WireLayout.lean shape)
rows.lean: D2Data: wX/wY/wS/wT/wU defs + IsSlot/IsTgt + g1/g2 + rho_n (copy of platform shape)

rows.name: ops (stage-1 word)
rows.source: deferred_23['ops'] verbatim (reordered design-B word; check_word.py replays it)
rows.lean: D2Data: packed 16-bit stream d2OPS (kind 1=src,2=add,3=fan + args; fan arity inline)

rows.name: hold (slot->node time lines)
rows.source: deferred_23['hold'] (nodes each slot holds over time; Schedule.chain_keys consumes)
rows.lean: D2Data: d2HOLDLENS + flattened 16-bit stream d2HOLD (153408 fields)

rows.name: start (slot starts)
rows.lean: D2Data: packed 16-bit d2START (tag 0=src,1=fresh + 2 args)

rows.name: out (outputs c,T->slot)
rows.lean: D2Data: clear list d2OUT (slot,c,T) 5313 triples

rows.name: ret (retained slot per centre)
rows.lean: D2Data: clear list d2RET 23 pairs + d2RETNODE 23 pairs

rows.name: readout_order (deferred slots)
rows.source: deferred_23['readout_order'] (the other R-11565=17301 slots read at F0, corner rank h)
rows.lean: D2Data: packed 16-bit stream d2READOUT

rows.name: sigma (deferred readout frames)
rows.source: deferred_23['sigma'] (primitive integer bases; frame len = h - corner rank, check_frames.py X re-derives)
rows.lean: D2Data: packed 4-bit-bias+1 stream d2SIGMA (209688 rows, row = 23 fields)

rows.name: corner ranks (h - dim sigma_u)
rows.source: derived: f[s] from sigma (dr.Schedule.f); histogram corner input
rows.lean: D2Data: derivable from d2SIGMA row counts; pinned via hist table

rows.name: vleaf_slots + vleaf_start
rows.lean: D2Data: d2VLEAFSLOTS 16-bit + d2VLEAFSTART (4/5-bit rows x 23)

rows.name: xs_order (X_S chain per leaf)
rows.lean: D2Data: d2XSN 16-bit leaf ids + d2XS chains 16-bit (flattened, lens derivable)

rows.name: deferred_v_order (deferred V gates)
rows.lean: D2Data: packed 16-bit stream d2LATEV

rows.name: node_dims (dim of every node frame)
rows.lean: D2Data: packed 5-bit stream d2NODEDIMS (key = index+1)

rows.name: late_dims (late-copy intersections)
rows.lean: D2Data: clear list d2LATEDIMS 1396 triples

rows.name: args (node DAG)
rows.lean: D2Data: packed 32-bit x2 d2ARGS (0=None else a+1)

rows.name: j (lift index of lifted additions)
rows.lean: D2Data: packed 5-bit stream d2J (keys implicit 1800..64042)

rows.name: leaf (X_S triples)
rows.lean: D2Data: packed 5-bit x3 d2LEAF (id = index+1)

rows.name: links
rows.lean: D2Data: packed 16-bit x3 d2LINKS

rows.name: outputs (c,T -> node)
rows.lean: D2Data: clear list d2WOUT (c,T,n)

rows.name: flag (23x23 int matrix)
rows.lean: D2Data: packed 8-bit-bias128 d2FLAG

rows.name: late (late copies)
rows.lean: D2Data: clear list d2LATE

rows.name: cov (adjoint garbage coefficients)
rows.range: dict per slot, rebuilt by transpose sweep
rows.source: derived: dr.Schedule.adjoint() over d2ops (check_word B over Z and F2)
rows.lean: D2Data: computable in Lean from d2OPS (fold); not emitted

rows.name: ylev (deferred levels per target)
rows.range: levels = dim sigma_u on targets of u
rows.lean: D2Data: packed 32-bit bitmap per target d2YLEV (bit i = level i+1)

rows.name: rk (chain-step ranks, design-B)
rows.lean: D2Data: clear list d2RANKS 21 pairs + count pin

rows.name: xdata (X_S chain deltas)
rows.range: deltas of vstart dims; sum x = h-1 asserted
rows.lean: D2Data: packed 5-bit stream d2XD (lens = d2XS lens)

rows.name: corner
rows.lean: D2Data: clear list d2CORNER + d2CORNERPLAIN

rows.name: hist (child widths, staircase)
rows.lean: D2Data: clear list d2HIST + childCount/rankSum decide pins + d2HIST_eq_bitR7 (decide)

rows.name: claims: D.claimed (a_b, kappa)
rows.lean: D2Data: pinned via d2HIST rankSum/childCount; kappa is proof-layer

rows.name: claims: W.claimed (base word)
rows.source: witness_23['claimed'] == BASE (pre-reorder) word: check_lifted B (R==claim) + hist_ok (rk==claim) + certificate()
rows.lean: D2Data: clear list d2RANKSBASE 21 pairs (base chain ranks, check_lifted-verified)
